components.name: ShadHero
components.description: Page hero at the top of a page: eyebrow (small caps line above), title, subtitle, meta facts (['Sun, 11 Oct', '14 bookings'] or [{ label, value }]), an aside on the right and up to two actions (actionLabel, secondaryActionLabel; onActionClicked, onSecondaryActionClicked). The aside is one headline figure (asideValue 12480 or '$12,480', asideLabel 'Revenue today' above it) or a short list of facts (asideValue [{ label: 'Open', value: 14 }, { label: 'Due today', value: 3 }], up to 4, asideLabel as their heading). Greetings and header facts belong in the hero itself: 'Good morning, Ada' as the title, one line of what needs attention as the subtitle, today's date and counts as meta chips, the one number that matters in the aside; never a separate Text or Stat floating beside or over the header. With an aside, the actions sit under the text. background 'plain' (no panel), 'tint' (a soft panel in the accent), 'gradient' (accent wash), 'image' (imageUrl behind a dark overlay, white text) or 'dark' (deep accent panel, white text); icon (lucide name) in a rounded tile beside the title; align left or center (the aside goes under the text); size compact, default or large. Styles accentColor (else the theme's primary), titleFontFamily ('serif', 'display', ...). Height: grows with its content (about 150px default, 120px compact, 220px large; add 40px for actions under the text)

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.
authoringHints.usage: The top of a page that should read as a product (a personal or customer-facing app, a dashboard home, a front desk): one hero in place of a heading and subtitle. background 'tint' or 'gradient' for a staff tool; 'image' with imageUrl, or 'dark', for a premium or consumer page; meta for the 2 or 3 facts that matter today; actionLabel for the page's main action (onActionClicked). A greeting is the hero's own title ('Good morning, Ada') with one subtitle line of what needs attention; the one number that matters goes in the aside (asideValue '$12,480' or 12480, asideLabel 'Revenue today' above it), or up to four header facts as asideValue [{ label: 'Open', value: 14 }] with asideLabel as their heading. Never float a separate Text, Stat or status line beside or over the hero: put it in subtitle, meta or the aside. With an aside the actions sit under the text; a hero narrower than 560px stacks text, aside, actions. About 150px tall, 190 with actions.
